utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Hi Claire. Great to see you. How has your week been?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Actually really good. I used the communication techniques we practiced and had a really productive conversation with my husband about our finances.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That's wonderful progress. How did it feel to have that conversation?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Really empowering. I stayed calm and used the 'I feel' statements. He actually listened this time. We ended up making a budget together.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That's a huge step. You modeled healthy conflict resolution. What made it different this time?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I think I finally stopped waiting for him to lead the conversation. I also started taking yoga classes which helps me stay calm day to day. I've been sleeping much better.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Yoga can be excellent for nervous system regulation. How often are you going?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Three times a week now. My daughter also got into her first choice university which was a huge relief for the whole family. We're going out to celebrate this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That's fantastic news. You've had so many positive developments this month. What's the one thing you want to focus on before our next session?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Continuing to check in with my husband. And I want to start the journaling practice you suggested. Same time next week?

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Absolutely. Great work this week, Claire. See you Thursday.
